name: AP_BANK_CHARGES
description: AP_BANK_CHARGES contains header information that you enter on the bank charges page. A bank charge is a fee charged by the customer bank, which is the transferring bank,  to transfer money to the supplier  bank, which is the receiving bank. You need one row for each bank combination that you define.

columns.name: BANK_CHARGE_ID
columns.description: Bank charge unique identifier.

columns.name: TRANSFERRING_BANK_BRANCH_ID
columns.description: Transferring bank branch identifier.

columns.name: TRANSFERRING_BANK_NAME
columns.description: Bank of customer, which transfers payment to supplier bank.

columns.name: TRANSFERRING_BANK
columns.description: Transferring bank. Valid values are ONE for specific bank and ALL when bank charge is applicable to all transferring banks.

columns.name: TRANSFERRING_BRANCH
columns.description: Transferring branch. Valid values are ONE for specific branch and ALL when bank charge is applicable to all transferring branches of transferring bank specified.

columns.name: RECEIVING_BANK_BRANCH_ID
columns.description: Receiving bank branch identifier.

columns.name: RECEIVING_BANK_NAME
columns.description: Bank of supplier, which receives payment from customer bank.

columns.name: RECEIVING_BANK
columns.description: Receiving branch. Valid values are ONE for specific bank, ALL for when charge is applicable to all receiving banks, and OTHER for bank other than the transferring bank.

columns.name: RECEIVING_BRANCH
columns.description: Receiving branch. Valid values are ONE for specific branch, ALL for when charge is applicable to all receiving branches, and OTHER for branch other than the transferring branch.

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_PRIORITY
columns.description: Settlement priority. Valid values are EXPRESS and NORMAL.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency for which bank charges are defined.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.
